name: Guitar Basics & Tuning
equipment: An acoustic or electric guitar, and a tuner (app or clip-on)
instructions: Standard guitar tuning, low to high string, is E-A-D-G-B-E -- memorize this order before anything else.
Use a clip-on tuner or a tuning app so every practice session starts from an in-tune instrument; an out-of-tune guitar makes even correct chords sound wrong.
Get comfortable with basic posture: guitar body resting on your right leg (or left, if left-handed), neck angled slightly up.
Watch today's video for an overview of beginner guitar chords before your first lesson.
